name: National Scholarship Portal
summary: Central and state scholarships for students — pre-matric, post-matric, top class education
hindi_summary: Chhatron ko padhai ke liye scholarship — school se lekar college tak
benefits: Various scholarships: pre-matric (₹1,000-5,000), post-matric (₹5,000-25,000), top class (100% fees)
eligibility: Students from SC/ST/OBC/minority/EWS families, family income below ₹2.5-8 lakh
